title: Small Changes, Big Impact
paragraphs: When Maya joined her school's environmental club, she expected to spend weekends cleaning the local river. Instead, the first meeting was spent looking at __1__ pile of lunch boxes. The club had noticed __2__ students threw away hundreds of plastic containers every week. They __3__(want) to find a practical way to reduce the waste.

Their first idea was to ask everyone to bring a __4__(reuse) box from home. However, many students forgot theirs, and some worried that washing a box after lunch would take too much time. Maya suggested a different plan: the school could lend out clean containers and collect them at the end of the day. The club __5__(test) the idea in one classroom for two weeks. Students paid a small deposit, which they got back when they returned a container.

explanation.context: Maya 看到的是“一堆午餐盒”，pile 是单数可数名词。
explanation.grammar: pile 以辅音音素开头，前面用不定冠词 a。
explanation.reason: 此空无提示词，考查冠词，答案为 a。

explanation.context: 俱乐部注意到后面所述的情况，即学生每周丢弃大量塑料容器。
explanation.grammar: that 引导 noticed 后的宾语从句，在从句中不作成分。
explanation.reason: 此空无提示词，考查连接宾语从句的连词 that。

explanation.context: 前文描述俱乐部发现问题，后文说明他们想找到解决方法，整段叙述的是过去发生的事情。
explanation.grammar: want 作谓语，应用一般过去时 wanted。
explanation.reason: 此空给出动词提示词 (want)，考查时态变化。

explanation.context: 学生需要从家里带一种可以反复使用的盒子。
explanation.grammar: 空格修饰名词 box，需要形容词；reuse 加后缀 -able 构成 reusable，意为“可重复使用的”。
explanation.reason: 此空给出提示词 (reuse)，考查词性转换。

explanation.context: 俱乐部把这个计划在一个班级试行了两周，后文继续描述押金和归还容器的做法。
explanation.grammar: 此处需要谓语动词，且事件发生在过去，test 变为 tested。
explanation.reason: 此空给出动词提示词 (test)，考查一般过去时。

title: A Library Built One Book at a Time
paragraphs: After college, Mei __1__(return) to her mountain village and found the community room filled with unused chairs. Younger children had few chances to read outside school, so she wondered __2__ the room could become a library. She began with a simple request: each family could give __3__ book it no longer needed.

The first collection was small, and some books were too __4__(difficulty) for young readers. A retired teacher sorted the books __5__ age and topic. A carpenter repaired the shelves, while children made signs. Mei kept a borrowing notebook so families could track each book. By giving each person a clear role, she turned the project from her private idea into a shared effort.

explanation.context: Mei 大学毕业后回到家乡，接着发现社区活动室闲置，故事按过去的经历展开。
explanation.grammar: return 是谓语动词，应用一般过去时 returned。
explanation.reason: 正文已标出提示词 (return)，此空考查时态变化。

explanation.context: Mei 不确定活动室能不能改成图书馆，这是一个“是否”的问题。
explanation.grammar: whether 引导 wondered 后的宾语从句，表示“是否”。
explanation.reason: 此空无提示词，考查连词 whether，答案是一个词。

explanation.context: Mei 邀请每个家庭捐一本不再需要的书，book 是单数可数名词。
explanation.grammar: book 以辅音音素开头，前面用不定冠词 a。
explanation.reason: 此空无提示词，考查冠词，答案为 a。

explanation.context: 第一批书中有些书不适合年幼读者阅读，后文提到教师按年龄和主题整理书籍。
explanation.grammar: too 后接形容词；difficulty 是名词，需变为形容词 difficult。
explanation.reason: 正文已标出提示词 (difficulty)，此空考查词性转换。

explanation.context: 退休教师按照年龄和主题整理图书。
explanation.grammar: by age and topic 表示“按年龄和主题”，by 在此作介词。
explanation.reason: 此空无提示词，考查介词 by，答案是一个词。

title: A Welcome at the Door
paragraphs: At our school's international evening, Lina shared a custom from her Japanese family. Before entering a home, guests often leave outdoor shoes by the door and change into indoor slippers. This helps keep floors clean, but Lina said each family may have different habits. She __1__(explain) that guests should notice what a host prefers. I learned it is polite __2__ ask before entering a room when unsure.

I tried on a pair of slippers and found them surprisingly __3__(comfort). Another student asked __4__ guests needed to bring their own. Lina said most hosts provide slippers, though visitors can check first. The conversation changed how I viewed customs. A tradition is not just a rule; it can show care for others. Asking respectful questions helps unfamiliar habits feel less strange and makes the visit more __5__(enjoy).

explanation.context: Lina 在学校的国际文化活动上介绍家里的习俗，文章以过去发生的经历为主线。
explanation.grammar: 此处需要谓语动词，主语 Lina 为第三人称单数；叙述发生在过去，应用一般过去时。
explanation.reason: 提示词 explain 是动词，结合过去时间变为 explained。

explanation.context: 作者说自己学到：不确定时，进入房间前先询问是礼貌的做法。
explanation.grammar: 句型 it is + 形容词 + to do sth. 中，to 引出真正的动作内容。
explanation.reason: 此处考查不定式符号 to，答案为一个虚词。

explanation.context: 作者试穿拖鞋后，接着描述穿着感受，语义上是“出乎意料地舒服”。
explanation.grammar: find + 宾语 + 宾语补足语；代词 them 后需要形容词说明拖鞋的状态。
explanation.reason: 提示词 comfort 是名词，需转换为形容词 comfortable。

explanation.context: 另一位学生想知道客人是否需要自带拖鞋，后文 Lina 回答大多数主人会提供。
explanation.grammar: whether 引导 ask 后的宾语从句，表示“是否”。
explanation.reason: 此处考查引导间接一般疑问句的连词 whether，答案是一个词。

explanation.context: 作者认为尊重地询问能让陌生习俗不再那么奇怪，也能让拜访体验更好。
explanation.grammar: more 后需要形容词作表语，说明 visit 的性质。
explanation.reason: 提示词 enjoy 是动词，需加后缀 -able 转换为形容词 enjoyable。

title: Why Some Seeds Wait for Rain
paragraphs: After a dry summer, a hillside may look empty, but many seeds remain in the soil. A brief shower wets only the surface. If a seed begins growing and the soil soon dries, its tiny root may __1__(survival). Some plants in dry regions respond mainly to longer periods of rain, which can soak deeper.

Growth begins when the seed coat opens. A small root grows downward, and a shoot moves toward light. At first, the young plant uses food stored inside the seed. Because this reserve is limited, timing matters __2__ great deal.

Some plants spread germination __3__ time: only part of a seed crop sprouts in one season, while the rest remain dormant. The __4__(develop) of each seedling depends on water and temperature. Under suitable conditions, a seedling may become __5__(visibility) above the soil. Spreading germination can reduce the risk that one dry spell destroys every new plant.

explanation.context: 短暂降雨只湿润表层；如果幼苗开始生长后土壤很快变干，幼根可能无法存活。
explanation.grammar: 情态动词 may 后接动词原形。
explanation.reason: 提示词 survival 是名词，需转换为动词 survive。

explanation.context: 前文说明幼苗早期依靠种子储存的养分，后文强调水分持续与否会影响生长，因此发芽时机很重要。
explanation.grammar: 固定表达 matter a great deal 意为“非常重要”；great deal 前需用不定冠词 a。
explanation.reason: 此处考查冠词 a，是无提示词的单词填空。

explanation.context: 后文说明同一批种子不会在一个季节全部发芽，剩余种子会继续休眠，之后再发芽，表示发芽被分散到一段时间内。
explanation.grammar: spread sth. over time 表示“把某事分散到一段时间里”，over 在此作介词。
explanation.reason: 此处考查介词 over，答案为一个词。

explanation.context: 句子说明幼苗的成长受水分和温度影响。
explanation.grammar: 定冠词 The 后、谓语 depends 前需要名词作主语中心词。
explanation.reason: 提示词 develop 是动词，需加后缀 -ment 转换为名词 development。

explanation.context: 在适宜条件下，幼苗长出土面，变得能够被看见。
explanation.grammar: 系动词 become 后接形容词作表语。
explanation.reason: 提示词 visibility 是名词，需转换为形容词 visible。

title: A Fairer Way to Book a Study Room
paragraphs: At school, the library tested an online system for booking study rooms. Students could reserve a room instead of waiting in line. Some worried it would be __1__(confuse), so the librarian added clear instructions and gave a short demonstration.

Students soon learned __2__ to choose a time and cancel a booking they no longer needed. The system sent a reminder before each booking. After a month, rooms were used more __3__(regular) than before.

Still, some students had limited phone access. The library kept a paper sign-up sheet __4__ anyone needed it, so both methods worked side by side. The trial taught the school that useful technology should make a task easier without __5__(exclude) students. In this way, convenience did not come at the cost of fairness.

explanation.context: 一些学生担心新系统不容易使用，因此图书管理员补充了清晰说明并进行了演示。
explanation.grammar: 系动词 be 后需要形容词作表语，描述 system 的特点；事物令人产生某种感受时用 -ing 形式形容词。
explanation.reason: 提示词 confuse 是动词，变为 confusing，表示“令人困惑的”。

explanation.context: 学生逐渐学会选择时间并取消不再需要的预约，句子说明他们学会了操作方法。
explanation.grammar: learned 后接宾语从句；how 表示“如何”，引导从句并修饰 to choose。
explanation.reason: 此处考查疑问副词 how，答案是一个词。

explanation.context: 一个月后，图书管理员发现自习室被使用的频率比以前更有规律。
explanation.grammar: 修饰被动结构 were used，需要副词。
explanation.reason: 提示词 regular 是形容词，加 -ly 转换为副词 regularly。

explanation.context: 有些学生无法方便地使用手机，图书馆因此保留纸质登记表，以备有人需要时使用。
explanation.grammar: if 引导条件状语从句，表示“如果”。
explanation.reason: 此处考查连词 if，答案为一个词。

explanation.context: 短文指出技术应让任务更方便，同时照顾手机使用受限的学生，不应把他们排除在外。
explanation.grammar: 介词 without 后接名词或动名词；这里需要动名词形式。
explanation.reason: 提示词 exclude 是动词，应用 -ing 形式 excluding。
